subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Twelve Apostles and Tribes
description: A quick win: understand Twelve Apostles and Tribes.

hook.text: Twelve tribes of Israel. Twelve apostles of Jesus. Twelve Imams in Shia Islam. Twelve organizes the divine.

buildup.text: When Jesus chose twelve apostles, he echoed the twelve tribes. The number wasn't random—it was deliberate.

discovery.text: Twelve knights sat at Arthur's Round Table. Twelve labors challenged Heracles. Myth and religion share the count.

twist.text: After Judas's betrayal, the apostles immediately replaced him to restore the number. Twelve had to remain twelve.

climax.text: Twelve represents a complete group. It's the number of wholeness in organized systems—human or divine.

punchline.text: Break twelve, and the whole structure cracks.

quiz.question: Why did the apostles replace Judas immediately?
options: To maintain the symbolic number twelve
